text.card: A star about 56 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 14.9 solar radii and 3.30 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,114 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Omicron Ursae Majoris
quotes.card: Omicron Ursae Majoris, formally named Muscida, is a star system in the northern circumpolar constellation of Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent visual magnitude of +3.35 and is located at a distance of around 179 light-years from the Sun.
